title.zh: 工作進度與績效檢討匯報 (高階戰略與 SCQA 決策)

slide_title.zh: 執行摘要與戰略訴求 (Executive Summary & The Ask)

zh: 現況 (Situation)：本期北極星指標 (North Star Metric) 達成率 [X]%，業務基本面穩健
衝突 (Complication)：受限於 [資源/技術/市場變動]，下個季度恐面臨 [X] 的增長瓶頸或風險
訴求 (The Ask)：今日旨在同步核心數據背後的洞察，並請管理層針對 [某項資源調配/跨部門決策] 進行裁示
en: Situation: North Star Metric achieved [X]%; core business fundamentals remain solid.
Complication: Due to [Resource/Market shift], we foresee a growth bottleneck/risk of [X] next quarter.
The Ask: Sync on data-driven insights and request executive mandate on [Resource Allocation/Decision].

speaker_notes.zh: 各位長官好。我們直接切入結論（Bottom line up front）：本期核心績效順利達標，但在為下個季度佈局時，我們預見了一個資源瓶頸。今天匯報不報流水帳，重點是向各位解析數據背後的驅動因素，並請求各位針對一項關鍵的跨部門資源調配做出裁示。
speaker_notes.en: Good morning. Bottom line up front: we hit our core targets this period, but looking ahead, we anticipate a resource bottleneck. Today's goal isn't a status update; it's to uncover the drivers behind the data and secure your mandate on a critical cross-functional decision.

slide_title.zh: 績效歸因與數據洞察 (Performance Attribution & Insights)

zh: 落後指標 (Lagging - 成果)：本月營收/產出達 [X]，環比 (MoM) 增長 [X]%，預算執行效率極佳
領先指標 (Leading - 驅動)：深入分析，此成長主要歸功於 [某項優化行動/新策略] 發揮綜效
差異分析 (Variance)：針對未達標的 [某次要 KPI]，根本原因 (Root Cause) 為 [X]，已啟動修正
en: Lagging Indicators (Outcomes): Revenue/Output hit [X], MoM growth [X]%, with excellent budget efficiency.
Leading Indicators (Drivers): Deep dive reveals this growth was primarily driven by [Specific Optimization/Strategy].
Variance Analysis: For the missed [Secondary KPI], the root cause is [X]; corrective actions are underway.

speaker_notes.zh: 數字本身沒有意義，數字背後的『為什麼』才是關鍵。我們的亮眼成果（落後指標），是建立在我們上個月執行的這項優化策略（領先指標）之上。至於未達預期的部分，我們已利用 5 Whys 找出根本原因，並已在修正軌道上。
speaker_notes.en: Numbers are meaningless without the 'why'. Our strong lagging indicators are the direct result of the strategic optimizations (leading indicators) we executed last month. For the variance in our secondary KPI, we've identified the root cause and are already course-correcting.

slide_title.zh: 風險雷達與不作為成本 (Risk Radar & Cost of Inaction)

zh: 綠燈項目 (On-Track)：[專案 A/B] 提前達成里程碑 (Under-promise, Over-deliver)
紅燈預警 (Risk Radar)：[專案 C] 浮現 [合規/技術/供應鏈] 風險，已啟動 B 計畫止血
不作為成本 (COI)：若今日無法決議增援 [某資源]，預估將產生 [X 金額/市佔率] 的隱含損失
en: Green Flags (On-Track): [Project A/B] hit milestones early (Under-promise, Over-deliver).
Red Flags (Risk Radar): Early warning for [Project C] on [Compliance/Tech] risk; Plan B activated.
Cost of Inaction (COI): If [Resource] is not approved today, we project an implicit loss of [X Amount/Market Share].

speaker_notes.zh: 在專案控管上，我們秉持「早報喜、早報憂」的原則。多數項目健康推進。針對紅燈項目，我們不只提出了預警，更準備了備案。我要特別強調『不作為成本』：如果我們今天不決斷這個資源缺口，下個月公司將面臨實質的虧損風險。
speaker_notes.en: We operate on an 'escalate early' principle. Most projects are healthy. For the red flag item, we haven't just raised an alarm; we have a mitigation plan. I must emphasize the 'Cost of Inaction': failing to resolve this resource gap today will translate to tangible losses next month.

slide_title.zh: 跨部門綜效與資源協調 (Organizational Synergy)

zh: 協作瓶頸 (The Friction)：目前與 [部門 X] 的協作因 [KPI 衝突/排程優先級] 產生推遲
戰略對齊 (Strategic Alignment)：已重新對齊雙方目標，皆以 [公司北極星指標/客戶價值] 為優先
雙贏解法 (Win-Win)：我們主動提議 [資源互換/流程妥協] 解開僵局，需高層今日協助背書
en: The Friction: Handoff with [Dept X] is delayed due to conflicting KPIs or priority sequencing.
Strategic Alignment: We've realigned both teams toward the ultimate [North Star Metric/Client Value].
Win-Win Solution: Proposing a [Resource swap/Compromise] to break the silo; requires your mandate today.

speaker_notes.zh: 部門間的摩擦往往來自 KPI 的不一致。遇到瓶頸，我們沒有選擇抱怨，而是主動與對方主管坐下來，將目標重新對齊公司的北極星指標。我們設計了一個雙贏的妥協方案，今天只需要各位長官點頭背書，我們立刻放行。
speaker_notes.en: Departmental friction usually stems from misaligned KPIs. Instead of pointing fingers, we sat down with them and realigned our goals to the company's North Star. We've crafted a win-win compromise; we just need your executive mandate today to execute.

slide_title.zh: 決策選項與次步行動 (Managing Up: Options & Next Steps)
slide_title.en: Managing Up: Decision Options & Next Steps

zh: 次期衝刺 (Next 30 Days)：聚焦推進 [核心任務]，承諾於 [日期] 前交付 [具體產出]
方案 A (建議)：投入 [X 資源]，可確保 100% 準時上線，並極大化市場紅利
方案 B (保守)：維持現狀不增援，需將上線時間推遲 [X] 週以確保品質。懇請裁示
en: Next 30-Day Sprint: Laser focus on [Core Task], committing to deliver [Specific Output] by [Date].
Option A (Recommended): Inject [X Resource] to guarantee 100% on-time launch and maximize market capture.
Option B (Conservative): Maintain current resources but delay launch by [X] weeks to ensure quality. Awaiting decision.

speaker_notes.zh: 最後，這是我們下個月的衝刺承諾。為了克服前面的瓶頸，我們準備了兩個選項給長官裁示。方案 A 是增加資源確保準時上線（我們強烈建議）；方案 B 則是維持現狀但延遲交付。請長官指示，確認後我們立刻展開行動。
speaker_notes.en: Finally, here is our sprint commitment for next month. To overcome the aforementioned bottlenecks, we present two options for your decision. Option A injects resources for an on-time launch (our strong recommendation). Option B maintains status quo but delays delivery. We await your directive to execute.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『月度/季度績效檢討匯報』。受眾為董事會或 C-Level 高階主管。內容必須採用麥肯錫 SCQA 架構與 MECE 邏輯：1. 開場直接破題，講述業務現況與戰略訴求 (Bottom Line Up Front)，2. 數據分析必須區分『落後指標(成果)』與『領先指標(驅動因素)』，並進行根本原因分析，3. 提出風險雷達並強調『不作為成本 (Cost of Inaction)』，4. 展現跨部門協商的雙贏格局，5. 結尾必須展現『向上管理 (Managing Up)』能力，提供具體的決策選項 (如方案 A 積極、方案 B 保守) 讓高層做選擇題而非問答題。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需極度精煉、數據導向且展現高階經理人的將才格局。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Monthly/Quarterly Performance Review' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors or C-Level Executives. Strictly use the McKinsey SCQA framework and MECE logic: 1. Start with Bottom Line Up Front (BLUF) and a clear strategic ask. 2. Distinguish between Lagging (Outcomes) and Leading (Drivers) indicators with root-cause variance analysis. 3. Highlight Risk Radar and the specific 'Cost of Inaction (COI)'. 4. Demonstrate cross-functional synergy and win-win conflict resolution. 5. Conclude with strong 'Managing Up' skills by presenting clear decision options (e.g., Option A vs. Option B) rather than open-ended questions. Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must be highly concise, data-driven, and reflect a senior executive mindset.
